item.title: Re: SCP-5640 The Stomach IDEA looking for greenlight
item.content:encoded:
With the changes you've made, it kinda feels like this has a big thematic/narrative disconnect in it: like, it still opens on dealing with the violent authoritarianism of the Brazilian government, but this is very quickly put aside for a story very focussed on the Foundation kinda playing around with it; and it feels…like the first stuff is a lot more unique and a lot stronger narratively and this just, really needs that to be explored more rather than introducing this big b plot about like, earthquakes and termination and an MTF getting eaten; or at least for that stuff to be tied directly into the actions of the government earlier?

Idk, I feel like you've certainly improved the narrative elements in this a lot but it's in a direction I personally don't really vibe with.

item.content:encoded:
Hello cybersqyd!

One of the biggest problems Brazil has today is the dissapearence of the victims from that period. So I figure out that the entity was an easy way to hide the bodies for the military and tied that with the historical context without taking the responsibility away from those who commited such atrocities.

Even today that period is nebulous, and thats also why I choose to increase the mystery of the creature by revealling little information about it.

I received other critics/suggestions to increase the infrmation with a exploration log, and I think it can work well with your suggestion of showing the horror instead of just talking about it!

Thanks for your feedback and have a great day! :D

item.title: Re: SCP-5640 The Stomach IDEA looking for greenlight
item.content:encoded:
I think my biggest issue with this is that you don't really do a lot with the concept: while 'thing what eats people' is kinda a big trope that's been done a lot, the angle of this being used by an authoritarian government is enough of a twist that this could still work. The problem here is that the narrative around that is very passive: there's no change since all that happens is like 'the Brazilian government used it and then they fell and now they don't': this feels like it needs a like, SCP-4511 style descent where they start off putting small stuff in and then it's escalating demands forces them into more and more extreme behaviour. The downside of doing this is that as a commentary on real events, it begins to feel like it explains them as a necessary evil; and so you have to be very careful to ensure that this feels like a deliberate choice.

I think the note from the soldier encapsulates what I mean: having someone in a note plainly state "What we are doing here is heinous. A blasphemy!" is orders of magnitude less effectively in writing than showing us that it's heinous, showing us the blasphemy directly, y'know? Show us why they do it, show is why they keep doing it, show us how horrible it is.

item.title: Re: SCP-5640 The Stomach IDEA looking for greenlight
item.content:encoded:
The entity has a historical context since it was used by a dictatorship to vanish those who oppose the regime.

Why wouldn't this dictatorship just kill people in a nonanomalous way? My biggest concern here is the lack of try connection between your political story and the anomaly. I would suggest trying to tailor this anomaly to be more thematically tied to your authoritarian government storyline…

Unfortunately the Foundation interrupted tests with Class-D personnel to stop further growth of the entity.

Additionally, this doesn't seem reasonable. WHY would the Foundation even begin testing with D-class in the first place? Ground penetrating radar would identify the organism and simple exploration with drones would avoid loss of human life. The inclusion of D-class just to be killed seems a bit old fashioned for my tastes.

Additionally, the massive subterranean organic SCP feeding on people is a little overdone imo, especially good example is SCP-2191 but there are others.

item.title: Re: SCP-5640 The Stomach IDEA looking for greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Hello!

I like how you imagined a Sarlacc because the entity I envisioned was completely different! i think this really increases the mystery behind the monster, letting the reader imagine more of it.

1) The idea of cattle was great! I am really going to add it to the document! Since the Foundation don't have enought information about the creature I think they would try to conduct some experiments and use Class-D subjects for more risk tasks, not exactly sending them to death. I will try to make it more clear!

2) My first idea was to put it in a region of Brazil that have small tremors that people hardly fell like 2.5, but in that same region on 1997 a tremor of 4.6 with no victims ocurred there. Since earthquakes in Brazil are really rare I was thinking about explaining those small tremors with the entity.

Thanks for your feedback! Have a great day! :)

item.title: Re: SCP-5640 The Stomach IDEA looking for greenlight
item.content:encoded:
While this is a little reminiscent of the Sarlacc, the historical value definitely makes it sufficiently unique. There's ony two maor issues:

1) The Foundation wouldn't use more D-Class than needed to verify what it did; while it can be cold, it does try to prevent cruelty, and just keeping it full using D-Class is a waste of resources. At some point they would at least debate substituting cattle or equivalent.

It would be interesting to see if they could feed it just enough to stave off hunger with out increasing its size.

2) Just because it's big doesn't mean that it could be felt using the Richter scale. If it is at the stage where it could be detected using tremors, especially ones that big, then it may be time to debate neutralizing it instead, especially if it is just being kept alive.

item.title: Re: SCP-5640 The Stomach IDEA looking for greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Oh, I love this but I suppose I'm biased because I'm Brazilian and our military dictatorship period both terrifies and fascinates me. I like how you took one of the core aspects of it (the disappearance of oppositors, the destruction of data, the lack of information) and turned it into an anomaly without taking the responsibility away from those who commited such atrocities.
Brazilian dictatorship is not a widely discussed or known topic and I think you can tie it well with the SCP universe. The strongest point of you idea seems to be the narrative and characters and not the anomaly itself, so I would focus on them. I truly hope you can get this idea into the main page!

item.title: SCP-5640 The Stomach IDEA looking for greenlight
item.content:encoded:
A horror/historical SCP submission used by the authoritarian military regime in Brazil.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, History

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch: A massive entity that behaves like a stomach, residing deep underground that came to the attention of the Foundation after sensors discovered tremors from the region. Everytime it consumes a victim it grows larger and larger.

Central Narrative:

UPDATED

+ show block
– hide block

Due to SCP-5640 size, containment has been enacted on-site. The surrounding land has been purchased, and at least thirty members of the task force are to be stationed alongside the perimeter undercovered to keep people out of the area. Small seismic activities detected in the region are to be blamed on tectonic plates by infiltrated agents. Tests with cattle are to be interrupted to avoid further growth of SCP-5640. No personnel are to be allowed inside the house and any civilians found near the ranch are to be captured and released upon application of Class-B Amnestics.

It was discovered that the site was used during the authoritarian military regime in Brazil (1964-1985), but due to the burn of the archives by the dictatorship little to no information was found about the entity. It is speculated that it was used by the Death Squadrons of DOPS (brazilian repressive police) to vanish with those who oppose the regime, since it was found partly destroyed documents about students, syndical leaders, deserters, communists and other people that were captured and lead by the military to the site.

It is also speculated that it was once human, or at least it had a humanoid overweight male form since a note that was left at the site with the documents reads (translated from portuguese):

“What we are doing here is a blasphemy! We are feeding that man in the pit with innocent people, and its growing larger and larger. And after all that, everything that he heard, echoing, trembling the walls, is its stomach, demanding more.”

Foundation wanted to better understand the growth of SCP-5640, and if poses a threat to humanity. Upon tests with cattle the entity mutated, undergoing radical changes to it physicality. Three limbs made from human arms stretched out to the cow dragging it to a lateral opening with human teeth that proceed to dismember and disembowel the animal. After 6-8 hours SCP-5640 is back to its slumber state, with parts of the animal still alive and in great distress popping out from its surface. During the period of one week it slowly assimilated its flesh, and them it proceeded to grown in size relatively to the mass consumed.

It is unknown why SCP-5640 keeps its victim alive during all the assimilation process.

After three tests with cattle, SCP-5640 created four limbs in the lateral of its body from his own flesh and tried to exit the pit. After failing five times due to its size, it went back to its slumber state. After the period of one month without contact with any living organism, it started its contractions again, causing small tremors of 2.5 to 3.0 at the Richter’s scale in the region.

A neutralization attempt was approved and team B-55 “Smoking Snake” was mobilized. Upon termination attempt with fire, SCP-5640 contractions reached a peak of 4.9 at Richter’s Scale, with the entity recovering soon after.

Team B-55 was them ambushed by two SCP-5640-01, a mass of flesh formed by human and animal limbs linked to SCP-5640 via an umbilical cord. The creatures dig into the walls and attacked the team when they were distracted with the tremors, leading to the death of B-55-01. Cutting the cord revealed an efficient way to kill SCP-5640-01, that just collapse in place. Unfortunately the team was not able to recover the bodys of B-55-01 and SCP-5640-01 and retreated immediately.

3 hours after the earthquake stopped a drone was sent underground and found a blood trail leading to the end of the corridor where SCP-5640 resides. It is speculated that the surviving SCP-5640-01 took the two body’s to the entity. Audio recordings registered human screams. Upon arriving in the pit SCP-5640 was found assimilating both the two SCP-5640-01 and B-55-01 that was in great distress.

Other neutralizations attempts are to be suspended to avoid further big earthquakes.

It is confirmed that without contact with living organisms to assimilate, SCP-5640 will avoid the loss of mass. It will not manipulate its flesh nor create others SCP-5640-01 and its reach will significantly decrease, unless it is in danger. The entity will keep making contractions twice per week, causing small tremors.

SCP-5640 is to be declared SAFE as long as it remains inside the pit.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The entity has a historical context since it was used by a dictatorship to vanish those who oppose the regime.

Also there are little to no information about the creature because the archives were destroyed, increasing its mystery, origin, and how it has grown so large that can create small earth tremors.

Additional Notes:

Why the dictatorship use the entity? One of the biggest problems Brazil has today is the dissapearence of the victims from that period. So I figure out that the entity was an easy way to hide the bodies for the military and tied that with the historical context without taking the responsibility away from those who commited such atrocities.

Also during the assimilation process, it keeps its victim alive. That reinforce the possibility that it may have been created by the dictatorship to torture political prisoners to get information.

Even today that period is nebulous, and thats also why I choose to increase the mystery of the creature by revealling little information about it.

Sandbox Page: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/zanilo

Thank you for the help and have a great day! :D
